title: Windows connection verified; Android delivery pending
summary: Paired WebSocket and real Windows VNC authentication now pass. The Windows desktop reports 1920 by 1080. APK compilation and phone visual acceptance are still pending.

changes.detail: Used Windows INI password checksums and the UltraVNC portable marker so the helper reads its fresh local configuration instead of migrated ProgramData configuration.
Required authentication to disconnect an active paired session and handled comparison of non-ASCII pairing attempts safely.
Protocol-only Windows runtime check and app interaction tests; no screen capture or keyboard input is performed by the protocol check.
Aligned package-lock metadata with application version 1.0.7.

validation.name: Source and focused tests
validation.detail: TypeScript, focused ESLint, 6 history tests, private-address validation, native screen interaction and bridge integration tests passed (9 focused tests total). Initial test-harness issues were corrected before these passes.

validation.name: Real Windows connection
validation.detail: Pairing, authenticated WebSocket upgrade and actual UltraVNC password authentication passed. Server desktop metadata: 1920x1080. TCP 5908 listens only on 127.0.0.1; bridge listens on 192.168.1.11:6081.

validation.name: Visual and phone acceptance
validation.detail: Browser automation inventory is empty. No visual desktop or keyboard/mouse acceptance is claimed. Phone HTTP reachability is being investigated; no firewall changes yet.

validation.name: Android delivery
validation.detail: Version 1.0.7 build 9 compilation is running. No APK installed, copied or published yet in this feature work.
